title: Ruhroh Experimental Economics Smoke
description: Experimental, conformance-gated comparison of accepted outcomes, token consumption, and implementation wall time on simple-newsletter. It is not enabled as a generally available Kestrel economics claim.

methodology.retryPolicy: Do not retry failed agent runs inside a sample. Re-run the full sample only for rerun-ledger-approved infrastructure exclusions.

suitableWorkloads: Fresh-session implementation work with a frozen repository baseline and a complete evaluator contract.
requiredEvidence: Declared benchmark-target and execution-adapter identities for every run.
Complete implementation token coverage from a conformance-proven adapter.
Implementation process start and terminal timestamps for every included run.
Run-plan weights and all failed work retained in the resource numerator.
hiddenWork: Provider-side preprocessing, cache preparation, and unreported routing work may remain outside observed implementation tokens.
Evaluator and publication packaging consumption is excluded from implementation economics v1.
gamingRisks: Optimizing only for the small smoke workload may not transfer to maintenance or multi-file product work.
Reducing tokens by omitting necessary validation can lower quality and fail the Wilson eligibility floor.
Changing run-plan weights after observing results would bias the frontier.

changelog: 1.0.0-experimental.1: Added conformance-gated token and implementation-wall-time objectives; cost is deliberately excluded.
acceptanceCriteria: Every target must satisfy the per-scenario Wilson 95% lower-bound floor.
Token ratios require complete implementation-token coverage for every included run.
The suite remains experimental until Kestrel structured telemetry passes synthetic and live two-turn conformance.
governance.contaminationReview: Uses the existing original simple-newsletter scenario; results must record the frozen scenario version and repository baseline.
governance.rewardHackingReview: The quality floor, failed-work numerator, fixed run plan, and evidence completeness gates prevent low-token incomplete work from becoming an eligible frontier point.
reviewChecklist: Confirm the adapter manifest and effective capability hash are present on every run.
Confirm implementation tokens and wall time exclude evaluator and packaging work.
Confirm no run or failed call was removed without an approved infrastructure exclusion.
Confirm Kestrel live conformance before making general availability claims.
governance.deprecationPolicy: Any methodology, objective, telemetry, or scenario change requires a new suite version and new evidence. Add cost only in a new version after cost telemetry conformance.
